programme.title: LIVEFEED
programme.desc: Nestled in the heart of Oxbury, Ontario, the Giant Pig Smokehouse opened in 2019, bringing Southern barbecue to life. The journey began in 2018 on Melissa's 30th birthday during a trip to Mexico when her brother proposed the idea of opening a restaurant. Embracing their love for smoked foods and recognizing the local events like Vankleek Hill Fair and Rib Fests, they decided to share their culinary passion beyond their home. The Giant Pig Smokehouse offers a variety of Southern barbecue dishes, with pulled pork poutine and brisket poutine being top sellers. Their pulled pork is described as sweet, saucy, and flavorful, often served in sandwiches or on poutines. The authenticity of their poutin gravy, made with meat drippings, is a highlight for many patrons. Customers praise the establishment for its delicious food and the welcoming atmosphere. Bianca from Gatineau, who tried the brisket poutine, found it amazing and fulfilling. McKenna and Matt from Alberta and Stoweville, Ontario, also shared their positive experiences, highlighting the quality of the barbecue and the friendly service. The owners emphasize the importance of patience in barbecue, advocating for slow cooking and marination to achieve the best flavors. They share their journey from backyard barbecues to a full-fledged restaurant, driven by their love for barbecue and the joy of sharing their creations with others. Working with family has its challenges and rewards. While the bond and trust are invaluable, there are moments of bickering that can be mistaken for conflict by customers. Despite these moments, the family's dedication to their craft and to each other shines through. The Giant Pig Smokehouse is not just a restaurant; it's a family business where love and dedication are infused into every dish. The secret to their success lies in the love and flavor they put into their food, ensuring every meal is as cherished as if it were served to their own family.

programme.title: Streetwise

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: We put the Wiesmann MF5 at the racetrack in Spa-Francochamps in the Belgian Ardennes to the test. Also: Audi A1 vs. Mini Cooper RS. And: the GT Academy 2011 qualifying rounds.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The Nurburgring 24 Hours is considered the most difficult long distance race in motor sports. Volkswagen set themselves this challenge with a car built especially for this occasion, their Golf 24.

programme.title: Jaguar D-Type
programme.desc: The high-achiever at the 24 hours of Le Mans. The Jaguar D-Type won the toughest endurance race in the world three times in a row.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.sub-title: Special: 24h of Le Mans - Track Days

In addition: Porsche's Turbo S model, the traditional top model of the brand's 911 production series.

programme.title: Chevrolet Corvair
programme.desc: Despite a production number of nearly 1.4 million units the Chevrolet Corvair is virtually unknown in Europe. It was innovative, efficient, modern and cheap. Nevertheless, it was slandered, torn apart and later reviled.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Winning the iconic Dakar Rally for a record 13 times, Frenchman Stéphane Peterhansel had a rather unusual career as he switched from motorbikes to cars and was enormously successful with both vehicles.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Alois Ruf is the founder of a small, but well-known car manufacturing company in Bavaria that specialises in building their own vision of street legal super sports cars on the foundation of Porsche bodys.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: From the 1950s to 1970s Hans Herrmann came to fame as a successful Formula 1 and sportscar driver for manufacturers like Porsche, Mercedes-Benz and Maserati who also won also the 24 Hours of Le Mans several times.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: People called her the "Queen of the Nordschleife" when she used to drive her Porsche or BMW racing cars at the Nürburgring's famous Nordschleife. Sabine Schmitz was a successful racing driver before she took a career turn by working as a TV presenter.

programme.title: 4x4

programme.desc: When the Audi A1 becomes the S1 and the Golf gets an R in its name, these small cars turn into all-wheel beasts. Also: the Mini Countryman gets a rejuvenation. And: a test drive with the best-selling Volvo XC60.

programme.title: Isle of Man - Tourist Trophy, Part 1

programme.title: Isle of Man - Tourist Trophy, Part 2
programme.desc: The most dangerous motorcycle race in the world on the Isle of Man. Marshals at the TT are responsible for the highest possible levels of safety.

programme.desc: SUVs usually are rather impressive right out of the factory, but there are many tuning and customizing options. In this episode we present Kelleners BMW X5, the Mercedes Brabus B63 and the Porsche Cayenne tuned by Techart.

programme.desc: When the Audi A1 becomes the S1 and the Golf gets an R in its name, these small cars turn into all-wheel beasts. Also: the Mini Countryman gets a rejuvenation. And: a test drive with the best-selling Volvo XC60.

programme.title: Isle of Man - Tourist Trophy, Part 2

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S1 - "Top and Bottom: The World Above the 60th Parallel and Below"

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S1 - "England and Wales: Castles, Baths, and Tubing"

programme.title: House Hunt S1 - "Family Affair"

And in Wellington will visa delays put an end to Sam & Maria\u2019s dreams of home ownership?

programme.title: House Hunt S1 - "Budget for a Dream"
programme.desc: In Auckland, Siblings Courtney and Tom joined forces with their partners and younger sister Natalie to buy their first home in Auckland..but will Natalie\u2019s change of heart put an end to their dreams of communal living? And in Hastings can childhood sweethearts Joe and Maria find a home for $240,000?

programme.title: House Hunt S1 - "Challenges"
programme.desc: Still reeling from the blow to their budget, can Hastings couple Joe & Maria regroup and find a home? And in Wellington Americans Bonnie & Matt want a warm, dry home for their family and they\u2019ve come up with a bold plan\u2026.

programme.title: Australia's Amazing Homes S1 - "Extreme Homes"
programme.desc: Australia is an enormous continent and it has profound variations in climate. Johanna and Pete find Australian designers who have responded to the radical climate by producing some very extreme architecture.

programme.title: Australia's Amazing Homes S1 - "Vintage Twist"
programme.desc: Johanna and Pete explore a collection of Australian vintage homes that have been masterfully renovated to meet the needs of modern living without destroying the past.

programme.title: Australia's Amazing Homes S1 - "Inventive Architecture"
programme.desc: Explore a collection of houses that have one thing in common - the designers have come up with inventive ideas and radical approaches to solving everyday design issues. It's both clever and inspiring with plenty of take home tips for the home renovator.

programme.title: A Taste of Travel S2 - "Thailand, China"
programme.desc: Join Scotty as he embarks on a trip through Thailand, before visiting QLD\u2026and Alana arrives in China.

programme.title: A Taste of Travel S2 - "China’s Great Wall"
programme.desc: Scotty\u2019s trip to Thailand heats up at a local cooking school, before he takes a segue tour of Brisbane, and Alana visits one of the wonders of the world \u2013 China\u2019s Great Wall.

programme.title: A Taste of Travel S2 - "Queensland’s Granite Belt"
programme.desc: Scotty finds his happy place, in Queensland\u2019s Granite Belt, and Alana get\u2019s a taste of Beijing\u2019s old city, before visiting the spice market in Istanbul.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S6 - "Home or Abroad"
programme.desc: Real estate broker Jasmine Xuereb helps home buyers Cindy and Andrew find their dream property. The biggest hurdle is whether the dream home is in their homeland of Canada, or in beautiful, exotic Thailand.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S6 - "Private Island"
programme.desc: Katerina and Mauricio are looking for one property in Canada and a holiday home in Belize, specifically on a private island. Real Estate Broker Tea Haxhillari helps the couple with their search in Canada as well as with private island hunting.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S6 - "Fabulous Resort"
programme.desc: Fernando and his investment group are looking to either buy or build a resort in Canada or Mexico with the help of Joe Petrella Construction.

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - "Hypnotherapy"
programme.desc: In Spain, two best friends reveal their big business plans at the end of a successful summer. A bar inches dangerously close to failure, and a rookie hypnotherapist finds his true calling in France.

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - "Shabby Chic"
programme.desc: A couple launches a chic B&B and restaurant in France while stargazers race to finish their observatory & a Costa Blanca bar family battles setbacks.

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - "Bar Owner Drama"
programme.desc: In France, the race is on to create a perfect B&B before a big booking arrives, tensions rise in Spain as two owners work together for the very first time, and a pair receive some early guest feedback.

programme.title: Traveling with Denella S4 - "Disney Cruise Line"
programme.desc: Sail away with Denella on board the Disney Dream. Who says Disney Cruise Line is just for kids?

programme.title: Traveling with Denella S4 - "Hard Rock Tampa"
programme.desc: Denella discovers her rhythm at Seminole Hard Rock Hotel & Casino Tampa.

programme.title: Traveling with Denella S4 - "Amawater Ways Danube"
programme.desc: Denella is in Europe cruising the Danube with AmaWaterways.

programme.title: Journeys in India S2 - "Ahmedabad: Land of Gandhi"
programme.desc: There is no figure in Indian history that rivals Gandhi. Bill explores the land Gandhi called home and in the process, learns about the man himself. But Ahmedabad is more than Gandhi\u2026its rich history and unusual architecture is revealed.

programme.title: Journeys in India S2 - "Calcutta: City of Living History"
programme.desc: There is no city in India that is more British than Calcutta. The former capital of British India, Calcutta has gardens, buildings and museums to prove it. Throw away any ideas you have of this giant city and discover the treasures it holds.

programme.title: Journeys in India S2 - "South India: Land of Superlatives"
programme.desc: Two of the greatest ancient monuments in the world are in South India\u2014Hampi and Konark. These two wonders of the world were lost to the west, but now are at the top of many bucket lists.

programme.title: Weekend Breaks with Gregg Wallace S2 - "Venice"
programme.desc: Gregg Wallace spends 3 days in Venice, enjoying great food, stunning sights, and kayaking through the city\u2019s famous canals.

programme.title: Weekend Breaks with Gregg Wallace S2 - "Athens"
programme.desc: Gregg Wallace explores Athens for 3 days, tasting great food, roaming ancient sites, and even performing in a Greek tragedy.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S4 - "Auckland"
programme.desc: Piri spearfishes with wahine toa Kerry in Auckland, spends a morning at Manukau Rovers, and joins All Black legends for a fishing charter.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S5 - "Bluff"
programme.desc: Piri\u2019s in Motup\u00F5hue, Bluff, where he\u2019s targeting local delicacy, Bluff oysters and Blue Cod. Then he jumps on some big machinery with Ex Southland Stag Jason Kawau.

programme.title: Paradise Kitchen Bali S1 - "Coconut"
programme.desc: Explore the boundless potential of coconuts with Lauren as she reinvents a calamari dish using coconut flesh, offering a taste experience that will leave you in awe and redefine your culinary perceptions.

programme.title: Paradise Kitchen Bali S1 - "Banana"
programme.desc: Indulge in the versatile world of bananas as Lauren skillfully crafts recipes, from banana flour sourdough bread to twist-infused pancakes, offering a tantalizing experience that showcases the endless possibilities of this humble fruit.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S5 - "Philippines"
programme.desc: Jonathan explores the Philippines, from Davao cacao farms to Siquijor\u2019s witchcraft, volcano rides, Manila motorcycling, and flying at Fort Drum.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S5 - "Season Recap"
programme.desc: Jonathan recaps the season, sharing disasters, blunders, lessons learned, and never-before-seen clips from his adventures.

programme.title: Streetfood Nomad: Kolkata S1 - "A Twist on the Classic"
programme.desc: In the northeast of India in the state of West Benghal, Kolkata lies on the banks of the Ganges River and is a melting pot of cultures and cuisines. Inspired by Kolkata's heritage, Will puts his own twist on classic Indian dishes, reinventing and infusing these recipes with unexpected flavours.

programme.title: Streetfood Nomad: Kolkata S1 - "Eastern Port"
programme.desc: The Eastern port Kolkata has been the centre for international merchants and migrants. The closest entry-point from China, in 1778 Kolkota became home to India\u2019s only Chinese community. They have left an indelible mark on Kolkata\u2019s architecture, culture and cuisine.

programme.title: The Delinquent Gourmet S1 - "Portugal"
programme.desc: Rodney is in Porto, Portugal. And although he's not yet a huge fan of Portuguese food, he's here to see if this seaside city can inspire him to change his mind. After watching the fishermen haul in their catch, Rodney cooks up lunch for one of the fishermen and his wife.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Tricks S1 - "The Best of…"
programme.desc: In the episode you can see the best of Around the World in 80 Tricks.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Tbilisi"
programme.desc: Cody discovers the unknown beauty of Tbilisi exploring abandoned Cold War bomb shelters, a derelict weather station and an abandoned cable car station.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Nantes"
programme.desc: Josh and ultimate traveler Lexie Limitless explore Nantes on a mechanical elephant and inline skates, and discover a deserted mine and a noble house.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Thessaloniki"
programme.desc: Cody goes off the beaten path in Thessaloniki, Greece. He runs over wagons at a train cemetery, explores a factory with drones and dives to a shipwreck.

programme.title: Access All Areas S1 - "Sahara"
programme.desc: Francesca is in Morocco to experience life on the edge of human capability and takes on a survival challenge walking alone amongst the sand dunes of the Sahara.

programme.title: Access All Areas S1 - "New Orleans"
programme.desc: Francesca Chiorando travels to New Orleans to explore Voodoo and learn about the aftermath of Hurricane Katrina.

programme.title: Access All Areas S1 - "Massachusetts"
programme.desc: Francesca is in the USA, in an area named The Bridgewater Triangle to discover if there\u2019s any truth to its claim as the most paranormal area of the USA.

programme.title: 7 Days S1 - "Day 4"
programme.desc: Jalou and Kevin travel to far colder places to challenge each other in an ice climbing competition.

programme.title: 7 Days S1 - "Day 5"
programme.desc: In the Chinese desert, Kevin finds out that desert racing is difficult. While in Bolivia, Jalou wants to prove to her brother that women can be better drivers.

programme.title: 7 Days S1 - "Day 6"
programme.desc: After exploring Peru, Jalou has to get over her fear when she goes white water kayaking. In Thailand, Kevin is feeling the pressure.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S5 - "Wellington"
programme.desc: Piri\u2019s in his hometown of Wellington where he hosts his own whanau for dive targeting mussels. He has a go at waka ama with ex Hurricane John Schwalger and his whanau and coaches the Wellington Boys High 1st XV.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S5 - "Raglan"
programme.desc: Piri\u2019s hosted by his high school friend, Jordan, & Ex All Black ,Liam Messam, where they target snapper, and he learns some jetski water safety from the team at Aotearoa Water Patrol.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S5 - "Coromandel Town"
programme.desc: Piri\u2019s in Coromandel Town, targeting snapper and gathering pipi. He trains the Thames Valley Women\u2019s rugby team and jumps on the Coromandel Zipline tour.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S6 - "Thailand: World War II Secrets"
programme.desc: Jonathan explores hidden bunkers, stashed warplanes, and forgotten memorials to uncover Thailand's suppressed World War II history.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S6 - "Indonesia: The Java Coffee Quest"
programme.desc: Jonathan traces Java's colonial coffee roots, explores mysterious temples, and joins the Jakarta Fire Department for a trial by fire.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S6 - "Indonesia to India: Capitals and Currents"
programme.desc: Jonathan examines Indonesia's massive capital relocation before following a spiritual quest centered on sacred water all the way to India.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S1 - "Australia's Largest Sand Island"
programme.desc: In this week\u2019s episode of Travels with the Bondi Vet, Chris finds an animal paradise in the most unlikely place, takes on a travel photography challenge on Australia\u2019s largest sand island and visits a city with a need for speed. Chris discovers a clever way to holiday for free in the Australian Tropics!

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S1 - "Japan and New Zealand"
programme.desc: When you\u2019re Australia\u2019s most popular vet, what do you do next? If you\u2019re the charismatic, hard working Dr Chris Brown, its time to shut the surgery and start exploring some of the world\u2019s most beautiful and sometimes bizarre places, people and animals.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S1 - "South Pacific Paradise"
programme.desc: In this episode of Travels With the Bondi Vet, Chris visits a city with more pets than children, experiences a 3-hour holiday in this south pacific paradise and goes on a 600 kilometer journey in the Australian outback to deliver some mail.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "The Berg River"
programme.desc: While Xander gets an up-close look at the tranquil and isolated Kersefontein Farm, Adam becomes a true armchair adventurer, wishing he was experiencing anything besides snowy Canadian weather.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "The Majestic Cederberg"
programme.desc: When Adam\u2019s power goes out in Winnipeg, he decides to spend the day building a snow fort. Meanwhile, Xander and his crew take a trip through Cederberg.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "From Elands to Lamberts Bay"
programme.desc: Up next, Xander and his team stop to surf the legendary left break at Elands Bay. After experiencing the peace and tranquility of the ocean with South African locals, Xander and his team hit a snag in their journey.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Kenya's Great Grasslands"
programme.desc: Bicycling is a safe and leisurely activity, until you decide to do it through the wilderness of Kenya with large lion, elephant and buffalo populations.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Wild Indonesia"
programme.desc: Bill had two wild icons he wanted to experience. The first is the largest lizard in the world - the Komodo Dragon. Walking among these massive beasts was unnerving to say the least. The other is Asia's one ape - the orangutan.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - "Cultural Indonesia"
programme.desc: Of all bucket list items, one stands out above the rest\u2014seeing one of the original reasons for starting the UNESCO World Heritage sites\u2014the massive temple of Borobudur.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Volcan Madera, Nicaragua"
programme.desc: The brothers attain their goal of riding motorcycles to the heart of Nicaragua, through the jungle to the isolated beaches of the Pacific coast and back inland: through Spanish-colonial towns, local villages and the huge volcanic island of Ometepe.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S1 - "India: Can Kolkata be considered a foodie destination of India?"
programme.desc: Liesel pinballs around a city known for its gastronomy, the forgotten hub of British East India trading company, Kolkata. From trying out what the bustling city\u2019s vibrant street food scene has to offer, to the lesser known gems, including, venturing into India\u2019s only Chinatown and sampling their delicacies. A tale of walking food tours, hole in the wall joints serving up North Eastern dumplings, messy fish markets, and of course, the pride of Bengal, the Hilsa fish. Is Kolkata up to par with the other major metropolitan cities of India? This episode finds out exactly that!

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S1 - "Nevada: What else is there in Nevada for foodies besides Vegas?"
programme.desc: This investigative mission starts off in the sin city atmosphere of the Vegas strip. After a gluttonous stint at a generic buffet, Liesel is inspired to do a road trip to find iconic gems in the state of Nevada. From ghost towns, to monstrous foodie challenges, to hole in the wall dive bars in the middle of nowhere, this trip has it all. Liesel finds the resurgence of Basque cuisine in Northern Nevada, and learns that Reno can do fine dining as well! A trip to Virginia city also reveals that the Silver State has some haunted bars where patrons from the 1800s are rumored to be still imbibing and spooking locals! It\u2019s a road trip in every sense of the word!

programme.title: Foodwise S1 - "Qingdao"
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Qingdao, China's beer mecca by the sea. With red tiles and green trees that make up the city's stunning scenery, our hosts embark on another foodie-journey with local delicacies and special guests.

programme.title: Foodwise S1 - "Wuzhen"
programme.desc: Join our hosts Tianran He and Eva May as they explore the boisterous event of Wuzhen's International Theatre festival, with colorful features of both theatrical and culinary nature.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S6 - "Holiday Dream Home Part 1"
programme.desc: Real Estate Agents Jasmine Xuereb & Laura Compagni team up to aid power couple Jamie and Jennifer in purchasing either a real estate investment in Canada or Belize.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S6 - "Holiday Dream Home Part 2"
programme.desc: Homeowners Patricia & Taheer are looking for a change of scenery. They are particularly interested in what Central America has to offer and Tea has found some beautiful, privateproperties in Belize that may be just what they are looking for.

programme.title: Food Unknown S1 - "Ireland"
programme.desc: It\u2019s the birthplace of Halloween, but the ghosts and ghouls which have canvassed the world have not scared up much interest in Irish cuisine. Mounting a classic motorcycle Jonathan tours a land of mystic traditions, boisterous locals, and iconic scenery. The world\u2019s most magnetic pub culture draws him in, border conflict pushes him out, and dark legends pull him around.
